releaseTitle: ATalk v3.11.2 — Clean Minimalist Sidebar, WhatsApp M3 Bottom Dock, Edge-to-Edge Wallpaper & Unified Themes
releaseNotes:
• 01 Clean Minimalist Sidebar: Removed the decoy lock button, simplified version text to clean 'ATalk v3.11.2', removed hardware chips and bloated subtitles, creating an authentic Telegram-grade drawer.
• 02 WhatsApp Material 3 Bottom Navigation: Full-length floating dock across Chats, Status, and Calls with active pill indicators, consistent labels, dynamic unread badge, and tactile haptics.
• 03 Genuine Chat List: Removed synthetic 'Saved Messages' row from the main chats list (readily accessible via drawer and search).
• 04 Unified Theme & Wallpaper Engine: Consolidated Appearance settings and in-chat Theme & Wallpaper studio into a single synchronized engine, removing redundant pickers, obsolete dialogs, and jargon.
• 05 Full Edge-to-Edge Wallpaper: Completely eliminated black top and bottom bands across all screens, allowing signature AGSL wallpapers to flow continuously from status bar to navigation dock.
